title: Baobab Contract Consumer Lock
description: A consumer's contracts.lock.yaml (EA Plan v2.0 EA-01A). It pins the immutable baobab-platform/shared commit the repository is built against and lists every Shared contract whose shape the repository implements or consumes. Repository-specific metadata MAY add top-level keys; it SHALL NOT replace the keys below.

repository.description: The canonical contract authority. Legacy nabhold/* sources are not accepted (EA-01B).

commit.description: Full immutable commit SHA on Shared main. Branches, tags and abbreviated SHAs are not pins.

items.description: Path of a consumed contract file relative to the Shared repository root. Every segment starts with a letter or digit, so '.' and '..' segments cannot occur.
